answer: Clone mills spawn cheap identities to occupy grading seats with almost no cost. A newcomer tends an oasis bond: lock 85 POA for 36 hours and issue 9 work tickets, each only after a 19-minute cooldown tied to one hardware fingerprint. Every ticket carries a daily saffron commitment, a 28-byte hash from an 11-leaf tree. The agent must pass two live summit audits in 96 hours, each with 4 peer countersigns on distinct tickets. Peers recompute the hashes and check 19±2 minute spacing. If two identities share a fingerprint, or an audit reuses a ticket, both bonds slash 42% and seats freeze 5 epochs.
